info.title: MyScoutee integration-groups
info.description: Typed calls to existing IntegrationGroups operations from integrations only. Native permissions and business behavior retained. Profile inputs are owner-reloaded by ID; no detached persistence documents. REAL/DEMO and job scope, 2 MiB requests / 8 MiB responses, bounded timeout and no automatic retries. Distributed lost-reply recovery remains milestone 16.
